prompt.project_info: Create a calm photorealistic casual portrait of an approved adult woman seated on white indoor stairs in soft daylight.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long straight dark hair, green eyes, natural makeup, calm confident expression, and one hand gently touching her face. She wears a beige fitted T-shirt with the subtle existing 'nano banana pro' text/banana graphic when typography is intentionally retained, black-and-white plaid pants, and a small visible arm tattoo.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait from a slightly low angle, subject seated on white stairs, white bookshelves behind, large window at the side, clean Scandinavian interior, relaxed hand-to-face pose, and plaid trousers clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window daylight, even gentle shadows, clean neutral tones, quiet casual elegance, and realistic fabric and skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: DSLR-style 35mm lens, f/2.8, high-resolution photorealism, shallow depth of field, sharp face and eyes, natural skin texture, accurate hands, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a calm photorealistic lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with long straight dark hair, green eyes, natural makeup, and a calm confident expression, seated on white indoor stairs. One hand gently touches her cheek and the other rests naturally. She wears a beige fitted T-shirt with the existing subtle 'nano banana pro' text and banana graphic only when the typography reference is intentionally retained, black-and-white plaid pants, and a small visible arm tattoo. Use a slightly low-angle medium portrait, white bookshelves, a large window, clean Scandinavian interior, soft natural window daylight, gentle shadows, 35mm f/2.8 perspective, sharp face, shallow background softness, realistic texture, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, altered typography, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face
